subject: Choosing bedroom colours and finishes
hook: Fitted wardrobes in the finish your bedroom actually needs.
gbp:
Planning fitted wardrobes this year? SUPERIO designs and makes made-to-measure wardrobes and bedroom furniture with you, including helping you choose a finish that works in your room's light.

It suits anyone replacing freestanding wardrobes, filling an awkward alcove or sloped ceiling, or planning a full bedroom with matching drawers and bedside cabinets.

What's included:
- A free, no-obligation design consultation, with finish samples viewed in your own bedroom
- Finishes including matt white, matt black, charcoal, black woodgrain and oak-effect, in matt, super matt or gloss
- Antique gold or matt black handles, with soft-close as standard
- An itemised quote with no hidden costs
- Manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley
- Installation by our own team

We work with homeowners in Congleton and across Stoke-on-Trent and Staffordshire. Tap Learn more to see our fitted wardrobes and arrange a consultation.
cta: Learn more and arrange a consultation
alt: A fitted bedroom set in black woodgrain with antique gold handles, made by SUPERIO.
